description: The flight-details forensic case (Phase 3 forensic-regression.test.mjs traced 6 real defects from a user's hand-pushed flight-details/asset-detail forms). This blueprint reproduces the same field names, tab layout, mustache-bound header, and detail-rail caption/checkbox shape at a trimmed scale, and asserts compileSpec()'s output stays Tier 1 + Tier 2 clean — the same claim the forensic suite proves at unit-test granularity, asserted here as an eval.
